import Algebra.AddSubmonoid
import Data.Nat.Basic
import Data.Integer.Basic
import Tactic

open AddSubmonoid

theorem lg_target {n : ℕ} (hn : Even n) : AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun x => x ^ n) = AddSubmonoid.nonneg ℤ := by
  let S := Set.range fun x => x ^ n
  have h1 : AddSubmonoid.nonneg ℤ ⊆ AddSubmonoid.closure S :=
    sorry
  have h2 : AddSubmonoid.closure S ⊆ AddSubmonoid.nonneg ℤ :=
    sorry
  exact Set.eq_of_subset_and_subset h1 h2
